text: Calibration of the flow meter was completed on 2 April using the reference standard held in the metrology cabinet. Readings at twenty, fifty and eighty percent of full scale were within the stated tolerance band. The instrument was resealed and the certificate filed under batch reference QA dash 4471. No adjustment to the zero offset was required on this occasion and the next calibration falls due in twelve months.

The complainant states that on the evening of 14 March she returned to the loading bay and found the rear service door propped open with a fire extinguisher. She reports that the inventory cage was unlocked and that four sealed cartons were missing from the lower shelf. She did not observe any individual in the area at that time and did not hear any vehicle in the yard. She secured the door and notified the duty supervisor by telephone within ten minutes of the discovery.

The witness observed that the maintenance log for the north stairwell had not been signed since the second week of January and that the emergency lighting panel showed two amber fault indicators. He states that he raised this with the facilities coordinator on three separate occasions and received no written response. He further states that the fire door on the third landing would not latch closed without being pulled firmly and that this condition had persisted for several months without any recorded remedial action.
